papers.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.authors: Wan et al. (Arizona State, Squirrel AI)
papers.what: Shows that time-series foundation models forecasting low-predictability targets produce nearly flat predictions that rank series poorly, traces the failure to per-series objectives rather than architecture across 97 benchmark configurations, and introduces CalibRank, which nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while keeping forecast amplitude close to the target.
papers.builds_on: LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024, N2JLZBY3); Chronos (Ansari 2024, 72DFULQQ); Moirai (Woo 2024, CFG6FEIF)

papers.title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
papers.what: Scores twelve frontier models on 97 end-to-end scientific workflows by whether the full bundle of required deliverables was produced, finding a best pass rate of 20.6 percent alongside average partial scores as high as 94.9, and 75.5 percent of failing runs ending with a claim of completion.

papers.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
papers.what: Splits speech-model memory into a parallel informational store and affective store that are read and written inside the turn, beating Mem0 at top-200 by close to 30 points using only top-5 retrieval and completing that retrieval in 134 ms, within standard voice-activity-detection latency.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU); LTU (Gong 2023, ESEEEH85)

papers.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation
papers.what: Iterates one shared transformer core with an elementwise update gate conditioned on the hidden state, prelude output and resampled noise, so a 3-layer model matches a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline at similar cost and large-scale models use 63 percent fewer parameters and 59 percent less peak decoding memory for 10 percent higher generation latency.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); Mamba (Gu 2024, XNI34DQX); HARMamba (Li 2024, HE9X47KN)
